svg.text: Week 3 Retail Platform: Online Boutique on Amazon EKS
11 Online Boutique services + new inventoryservice · dev and prod on one cluster, isolated by namespace · event-driven order flow
CI/CD · GitHub Actions (GitHub Flow: short-lived branches → PR → main)
Amazon EKS · 3 × t3.medium nodes across 2 AZs · HPA on stateless services
namespace boutique-dev · boutique-prod is identical, with its own DB, Redis, queues and IAM roles
NetworkPolicies block traffic between the two namespaces · ResourceQuotas cap each one
Data stores and queues: one set per environment · private · encrypted at rest with KMS
12 repositories · immutable commit-SHA tags · scan on push
routes each event type to its queue with a rule
checkout → its own env's bus only
checkout saves the order as PENDING in RDS MySQL, then publishes OrderCreated to EventBridge
rule → inventory-q → inventoryservice reserves stock in DynamoDB, publishes InventoryReserved or InventoryFailed
rule → order-status-q → Lambda sets the order to CONFIRMED or FAILED in MySQL, publishes OrderStatusUpdated
rule → notification-q → emailservice sends exactly one email and logs it in DynamoDB
• Each queue retries a message 3 times, then moves it to its dead-letter queue → alarm
• Consumers are idempotent: a duplicate delivery never creates a second order or email
• A slow or broken consumer only backs up its own queue
